description: Validation of a resolution (Story 31.7, §6.9 items 4 and 5): when the owner's reply or Done moves a blocked issue to Block Resolved, the supervisor's resolution pass queues this job on the host tier with the planner leg's model and effort (passed at enqueue, so no model here) and a payload naming the issues. The tk-studio-track session runs `track.py validate --check` per issue (the owner's transition, from the changelog; the reason and the reply, from local memory), tests what the reason names or judges the reply, then `--pass` (the issue back to In Progress or To Do, any ruling written into the paused story's spec; the supervisor resumes the paused run) or `--fail` (a follow-up block comment, back in the Inbox). The agent seat only, never the owner's. Shipped undeclared, as atlassian-sync-back is; the session commits nothing.
